title.zh: 卡尔曼滤波 · 在预测与测量之间称重
title.en: Kalman Filter · Weighing Prediction Against Measurement

desc.zh: 真实状态永远看不见：模型预测一份、带噪测量一份，卡尔曼按各自的不确定度当场算出该信谁几成。增益 K 如何自己定下来、如何从位置估出没测过的速度——全是递推真算。
desc.en: The true state is never visible: a model predicts, a noisy sensor measures, and the Kalman filter weighs the two by their uncertainties, live. How gain K settles itself, and how velocity gets estimated from position alone — every step from the real recursion.
